title: Give Thanks to the Lord
lyrics: [A]Give thanks to the Lord our God and King
[D]For He is good, He is above all things
[A]With a mighty hand and outstretched arm
Fo[A]rever God is faithful, fo[F#m]rever God is strong
Fo[E]rever God is with us fo[D]rever, and [D]ever fore[A]ver
[A]From the rising to the setting sun
And by the [D]grace of God we will carry on
